definitions.gloss: to get through; to overcome; to pull through
definitions.explanation: To survive or overcome a difficult situation, crisis, or challenge. Emphasizes managing to escape or endure something tough.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}け→切り抜く：06054_kirinuku⟧た。
なん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧な⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}けること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: We somehow managed to get through the difficult situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不景気|ふけいき}→不景気：18557_fukeiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦うまく→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}け→切り抜く：06054_kirinuku⟧て、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{業績|ぎょうせき}→業績：04873_gyouseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}している→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: The company successfully weathered the recession and its performance has now recovered.

notes:
FORMS:
A compound verb from ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (to cut) + ⟦{抜|ぬ}ける→抜ける：02385_nukeru⟧ (to pass through). The image is of cutting one's way through obstacles.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}ける (to get through a crisis)
- ⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}ける (to overcome difficulty)
- ⟦{窮地|きゅうち}→窮地：08684_kyuuchi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{切|き}り{抜|ぬ}ける (to escape a tight spot)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{乗|の}り{越|こ}える→乗り越える：04620_norikoeru⟧: to overcome — emphasizes conquering rather than surviving
- ⟦{凌|しの}ぐ→凌ぐ：07388_shinogu⟧: to endure, to weather — focuses on endurance
